title: Name The Group's chapter leaders, central admins and circle hosts

source.ref: Paste README 'Not in this paste (section D)'.

detail: Section D of The Group handoff. The Network Space has no central admins, so nobody but the owner can read the roll-up report or approve chapter events for the Network calendar. Chapter leaders and circle hosts are not recorded either. WAITS ON JUNE: who leads each of the six chapters, who the central admins are, and who hosts each circle. When she answers, a thread writes an idempotent role paste (space_members admin rows, circle host rows) for Daniel to run in Supabase.
notes: Filed 2026-10-20 at Daniel's request ("Put June's work in the backlog"). Open and blocked on June An's answers, not on code. Not parked: parking needs a ruling ADR (HYG-161).

verify.evidence: OPEN. Closes when production shows the named central admins on the Network Space, a leader on each of the six chapters, and a host on each circle June named.
